description_en: Retrieves a list of custom rules
name: ListCloudSiemCustomizeRules

parameters.help_en: The ID of the custom rule
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间，单位毫秒
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，单位毫秒
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The threat level. The value is a JSON array. Valid values:

serious: high

suspicious: medium

remind: low
parameters.help_zh:
威胁等级，JSON数组格式。取值：
serious：高危
suspicious：中危
remind：低危
parameters.name: threat_level

parameters.help_en: The name of the rule. The name can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), and periods (.)
parameters.help_zh: 规则名称，仅支持字母、数字、下划线、点
parameters.name: rule_name

parameters.help_en:
The type of the rule. Valid values:

predefine: predefined

customize: custom
parameters.help_zh:
规则类型。取值：
predefine：预定义
customize：自定义
parameters.name: rule_type

parameters.help_en:
The status of the rule. Valid values:

0: initial

10: testing with simulated data

15: testing with business data

20: testing with business data is complete

100: published
parameters.help_zh:
规则状态。取值：
0：初始状态
10：模拟数据测试
15：业务数据测试中
20：业务数据测试结束
100：规则上线
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The field that you use to sort the custom rules. Valid values:

GmtModified: sorts the rules by modification time.

Id: sorts the rules by rule ID. This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
规则列表排列字段。 取值：
GmtModified：基于修改时间排序
Id：基于规则id排序（默认）
parameters.name: order_field

parameters.help_en:
The order in which you want to sort the custom rules. Valid values:

desc: descending order

asc: ascending order
parameters.help_zh:
事件列表排列方向。 取值：
desc：降序排列
asc：升序排列
parameters.name: order

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1
parameters.help_zh: 列表当前页号，大于等于1
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 列表每页条数，最大不超过100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The view type.

0: the view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.

1: the view of all members in the enterprise
parameters.help_zh:
视图类型。

0：当前阿里云账号视图。
1：企业下所有账号的视图
parameters.name: role_type

parameters.help_en: The user ID that is used to switch the administrator's view to the view of a member
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for

parameters.help_en:
The region where the data management center of Threat Analysis is deployed. You must select the region where your assets reside. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: your assets are in the Chinese mainland or Hong Kong (China).

ap-southeast-1: your assets are outside China
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地与中国香港
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page

AlertTypeMds.description_en: The Medusa code of the threat type

Aliuid.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account

DataType.description_en:

0: the view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.
1: the view of all members in the enterprise
DataType.description_zh:

EventTransferExt.description_en: The extended information for event generation. This parameter is returned only when EventTransferType is set to allToSingle. The value is a JSON-formatted string that indicates the window length and unit for alert aggregation. You must unescape the HTML escape characters in the string
EventTransferExt.description_zh: 事件生成扩展信息。当eventTransferType值为allToSingle，该字段有值，表示告警聚合窗口的周期长度以及周期单位（需要对html转义字符进行反向转义）
EventTransferExt.title_zh: 事件生成扩展信息 当eventTransferType值为allToSingle该字段有值 表示告警聚合窗口的周期长度以及周期单位(需要对html转义字符进行反向转义)。

EventTransferSwitch.description_en:
Indicates whether to convert alerts into events. Valid values:

0: no

1: yes
EventTransferSwitch.description_zh:
告警是否转换事件开关。取值：
0：不转换
1：转换
EventTransferSwitch.title_zh:
告警是否转换事件开关。 取值：
0：不转换
1：转换

EventTransferType.description_en:
The event generation method. Valid values:

default: the default method

singleToSingle: An event is generated for each alert.

allToSingle: An event is generated for all alerts within a period
EventTransferType.description_zh:
事件生成方式。取值：
default：默认内置方式
singleToSingle：每个告警生成一个事件
allToSingle：周期内告警生成一个事件
EventTransferType.title_zh:
事件生成方式。 取值：
default:默认内置方式
singleToSingle：每个告警生成一个事件
allToSingle：周期内告警生成一个事件

GmtModified.description_en: The time when the custom rule was last updated
GmtModified.description_zh: 自定义规则最后更新时间
GmtModified.title_zh: 自定义规则最后更新时间。
